small_sample_nonparametric_resolution.methodological_implication: With n=5 seeds per arm, even complete non-overlap of the two arms achieves a minimum two-sided rank/permutation p-value of 2/252 = 0.00794 (which is < 0.05 unadjusted on all 24 tests, but mathematically cannot reach p_Holm < 0.05 under 8-way [min 0.0635] or 24-way [min 0.1905] Holm multiplicity correction) and a minimum two-sided paired sign-flip p-value of 2/32 = 0.0625. Therefore, sub-0.001 p-values and 8-way/24-way Holm significance rely on the parametric t-distribution of seed-level means (which by the Central Limit Theorem average M=1,000 passages per seed).

jensen_inequality_gen_ppl_audit.mean_token_nll: Unbiased sample mean of sequence/token negative log-likelihoods: E[NLL_hat_M] = mu_NLL for all M >= 1.
jensen_inequality_gen_ppl_audit.gen_ppl_convexity_bias: Gen-PPL = exp(NLL_hat_M) is a strictly convex nonlinear transformation of the sample mean NLL. By Jensen's inequality, E[exp(NLL_hat_M)] > exp(E[NLL_hat_M]), with second-order Taylor bias approx Gen-PPL * Var(NLL_hat_M) / 2 = O(1/M). It is asymptotically consistent as M -> infinity, has < 0.03% finite-sample convexity bias at M >= 500, and has zero differential bias when comparing equal-M conditions.

phase5_semantic.why_abtt3_cos_dist_equals_1p0039: Mathematical Identity: After centering X across M=250 passages and removing the top 3 PCs (all-but-the-top, Mu & Viswanath 2018), the sum of all M row vectors is nearly zero. For any set of M unit vectors {u_i} whose sum ||sum u_i||^2 >= 0, the average pairwise cosine distance is bounded above by M/(M-1) = 250/249 = 1.004016. Because ABTT-3 makes the M=250 embeddings nearly zero-mean on the unit sphere, mean pairwise cosine distance mechanically saturates near 250/249 = 1.0039-1.0040 with tiny differences (+0.0000 to +0.0001). Thus ABTT-3 cosine distance is pinched against the spherical simplex bound, whereas Vendi Score depends on the full eigenvalue spectrum of the Gram matrix K = E E^T / M and remains unpinched.

phase8_compute.nfe_discrepancy_explanation: 1. Actual Executed Per-Sequence Backbone Evaluations (K + 1 = 33 for K=32; 65 for K=64): In elfx/sample.py (rollout, lines 133-175) and ELF/src/utils/sampling_utils.py, each integration step i in {0..K-1} executes exactly one distilled forward pass model(z_input, t_i, self_cond_cfg_scale=s_cfg) with z_input = [z_t, u_t] in R^{B x L x 128} (where u_0 = 0 at step i=0), totaling K = 32 rollout evaluations per sequence regardless of whether SC-CFG = 1.0 or SC-CFG > 1.0. After the K-step rollout finishes, _dlm_decode_batch(bundle, z_final, sc_cfg=sc_cfg, chunk=decode_chunk) (elfx/sample.py lines 180-184 and ELF/src/utils/generation_utils.py lines 110-130) executes 1 terminal decoding pass model(z_input=[z_final, 0], t=1, self_cond_cfg_scale=s_cfg, decoder_step_active=True) per sequence to map the terminal continuous latent z_final in R^{B x L x 64} to vocabulary logits in R^{B x L x 50257}. This yields exactly K + 1 = 33 per-sequence backbone evaluations (and K + ceil(B / decode_chunk) = 32 + ceil(64 / 32) = 34 module calls per batch of B=64 when decode_chunk=32). 2. Theoretical Undistilled CFG Formula (K = 32 vs 2K - 1 = 63 rollout passes): A standard two-pass undistilled Classifier-Free Guidance sampler would evaluate 1 pass at step 0 and 2 passes at steps 1..K-1 when SC-CFG > 1.0 (totaling 2K - 1 = 63 rollout passes, or 64 including terminal decode) vs. K = 32 rollout passes (33 including terminal decode) when SC-CFG = 1.0. 3. Legacy Summary Metadata Field (2K = 64): The summary.json metadata logger recorded a static 2K = 64 placeholder. We distinguish all three quantities explicitly in Table 5.

m1000_vs_m500_corpus_bias_audit.discovery: In Notebook 09 (ACE intervention), Conditions 1_baseline_SC1 and 2_baseline_SC4 reused the M=1,000 runs from Notebook 08, whereas Conditions 3..8 were generated at M=500 sequences/seed. While per-sample expectations (Gen-PPL, H_ps, rep-4, within-distinct-2) are strictly unbiased with respect to M, corpus-pooled/reference-pool metrics (especially Self-BLEU, which evaluates each hypothesis against M-1 references, and MAUVE, which compares M generated passages against 1,000 reference passages) shift when M drops from 1,000 to 500.

jensen_inequality_gen_ppl_audit.mean_token_nll: Unbiased sample mean of sequence/token negative log-likelihoods: E[NLL_hat_M] = mu_NLL for all M >= 1.
jensen_inequality_gen_ppl_audit.gen_ppl_convexity_bias: Gen-PPL = exp(NLL_hat_M) is a strictly convex nonlinear transformation of the sample mean NLL. By Jensen's inequality, E[exp(NLL_hat_M)] > exp(E[NLL_hat_M]), with second-order Taylor bias approx Gen-PPL * Var(NLL_hat_M) / 2 = O(1/M). It is asymptotically consistent as M -> infinity, has < 0.03% finite-sample convexity bias at M >= 500, and has zero differential bias when comparing equal-M conditions.
